results.evidence: In `products/tasks/backend/models.py`, `TaskRun.mark_failed` captures the failure event including the backend: `"sandbox_backend": (self.state or {}).get("sandbox_backend") or "modal",`.

In `products/tasks/backend/temporal/process_task/workflow.py`, internal failure handling in `except Exception as e` calls `await self._update_task_run_status("failed", ...)` passing `sandbox_backend=self._sandbox_backend`, which in `update_task_run_status.py` executes `_capture_terminal_analytics` recording `"sandbox_backend": input.sandbox_backend or (task_run.state or {}).get("sandbox_backend") or "modal",`.

In `products/tasks/backend/temporal/process_task/activities/update_task_run_status.py`, line 266 of `_capture_terminal_analytics` sets `"sandbox_backend": input.sandbox_backend or (task_run.state or {}).get("sandbox_backend") or "modal",`, utilizing `input.sandbox_backend` from the executing run when provided and otherwise falling back to `(task_run.state or {}).get("sandbox_backend")`.

In `products/tasks/backend/temporal/process_task/workflow.py`, `ResumedSandboxState` defines `sandbox_backend: str | None = None`. Line 1221 restores `self._sandbox_backend = input.resumed_sandbox.sandbox_backend if input.resumed_sandbox else None`, and lines 1223-1224 skip re-resolution when already set (`if self._sandbox_backend is None: self._sandbox_backend = self.context.sandbox_backend`). Continued inputs also preserve it: `sandbox_backend=self._sandbox_backend or self.context.sandbox_backend`.

In `products/tasks/backend/temporal/process_task/workflow.py`, lines 1221-1224 execute `self._sandbox_backend = input.resumed_sandbox.sandbox_backend if input.resumed_sandbox else None` followed by `if self._sandbox_backend is None: self._sandbox_backend = self.context.sandbox_backend`. When a continued run reattaches without a backend value handed over, it overwrites `self._sandbox_backend` with the freshly re-resolved `self.context.sandbox_backend` rather than reading the backend recorded in the run's stored state for that sandbox or falling back to the default backend.

In `products/tasks/backend/models.py` (`"sandbox_backend": (self.state or {}).get("sandbox_backend") or "modal",`) and `products/tasks/backend/temporal/process_task/activities/update_task_run_status.py` (`"sandbox_backend": input.sandbox_backend or (task_run.state or {}).get("sandbox_backend") or "modal",`), `sandbox_backend` is unconditionally included as a dictionary key and defaults to `'modal'` even when there is no sandbox associated, with no check to omit unrecognized backend identifiers.

In `products/tasks/backend/models.py` (lines 3113-3117) and `update_task_run_status.py` (lines 263-271), pre-existing fields are preserved unchanged alongside `sandbox_backend`: `"error_message": truncate_error_message(input.error_message or task_run.error_message)`, `"error_type": input.error_type or "unspecified"`, `"duration_seconds": task_run._duration_seconds()`, and `"termination_reason": termination_reason`.
